column3: the water surface ripples gently, sunlight caustics shimmer across the pool floor, the shadow edge creeps slowly, the hedges stir faintly
dust motes drift in the sunlight, warm light slowly shifts across the counter and the floor beyond, the trees outside the far window sway faintly
a slow highlight travels along the machined steel thread as the light source moves, a subtle shimmer in the bokeh, nothing else moves
the warm sunlight on the wall slowly brightens and drifts, the trees outside the window sway gently in a breeze, faint dust in the light
the hands and the nail gun hold completely still, the low sun flares and shifts softly across the shingles, the treeline behind sways faintly, a slight heat shimmer
leaves on the trees move in a breeze, clouds drift slowly across the sky, sunlight on the solar panels brightens and glints
the dog holds its pose and breathes gently, its fur stirs in a light breeze, it blinks once, the soft bokeh behind it shifts, the mouth stays as it is
the raking light slowly sweeps across the paper texture, the graphite line glints as the light angle changes, the shadow at the top edge drifts
the door and the gloved hand stay exactly where they are in frame, the door does not swing, sea light shimmers outside, warm haze drifts, the cypress and shrubs sway faintly in a breeze
the doorway on the left stays in frame, afternoon sunlight moves slowly across the plaster wall, dust motes drift in the light from the windows, the trees outside sway faintly
